name: β-Phellandrene

pubchem.title: Beta-Phellandrene
pubchem.description: Beta-phellandrene is one of a pair of phellandrene cyclic monoterpene double-bond isomers in which one double bond is exocyclic (cf. alpha-phellandrene, where both of them are endoocyclic). It has a role as a plant metabolite.

consumer_summary.what_it_is: β-Phellandrene is a cyclic monoterpene, a type of aromatic molecule that plants use to interact with their environment. As a volatile organic compound, it contributes to the complex, fresh scents of many herbs and trees we encounter daily. You likely taste and smell it whenever you cook with fresh spices or walk through a pine forest.
consumer_summary.found_in: This terpene is widely distributed in nature, featuring prominently in culinary herbs like dill, ginger, coriander, and parsley. It is also a key component in the essential oils of trees such as spruce, juniper, and tea tree.
consumer_summary.why_researchers_care: Researchers are drawn to β-phellandrene for its broad presence in medicinal and culinary plants, exploring its potential as a natural defense molecule. Much of the current interest centers on its ability to fight off microbes and oxidative stress, as well as its potential role in managing inflammation. The strongest evidence so far comes from human observational studies (Oxford level 2b), which are helping scientists map out exactly how this terpene interacts with human biology and pathogens.

structure_function.statement: β-Phellandrene is being studied for its ability to support the body's defenses against bacterial and fungal microbes.
structure_function.basis: This rests on 27 papers, including human observational and in vitro microbial sensitivity tests.

structure_function.statement: Early work points toward this terpene acting as an antioxidant that may help neutralize oxidative stress.
structure_function.basis: This is based on 13 papers, including human observational research and animal studies.

structure_function.statement: This molecule may support healthy inflammatory responses.
structure_function.basis: This is supported by 5 papers spanning human observational, animal, and lab models.

hypothesized_benefits.hypothesis: Researchers are exploring whether β-phellandrene can act as an effective, plant-derived insect repellent, which could offer a natural alternative to synthetic bug sprays.
hypothesized_benefits.study_to_test_it: A randomized controlled trial in humans comparing a standardized topical β-phellandrene formulation against a standard repellent to measure mosquito landing rates over an 8-hour period.

hypothesized_benefits.hypothesis: Scientists are investigating whether the phytochemical properties of β-phellandrene might play a role in cellular health and cancer biology.
hypothesized_benefits.study_to_test_it: A randomized, placebo-controlled clinical trial evaluating the effects of a β-phellandrene-rich extract on specific biomarkers of cellular proliferation in patients over a 6-month period.

consumer_summary.cautions: In industrial settings, concentrated β-phellandrene is considered an occupational exposure hazard as an acute solvent toxin, though this is not a concern at normal dietary levels.
consumer_summary.evidence_at_a_glance: Best evidence so far is human observational work (Oxford 2b); most of the rest is animal and lab research focusing on its antimicrobial and antioxidant properties.
